steps.code:
# Get all liked songs by paginating
access_token = login_result['access_token']
all_liked_songs = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_liked_songs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print("Total liked songs:", len(all_liked_songs))
liked_song_ids = {song['song_id'] for song in all_liked_songs}
print("Liked song IDs:", liked_song_ids)

steps.code:
# Identify positions of liked songs in the queue and remove them from highest to lowest
access_token = login_result['access_token']
queue = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access_token)
liked_song_ids = {130, 132, 134, 265, 268, 251, 82, 275, 58, 219, 60}

# Find positions of liked songs in the queue
positions_to_remove = [song['position'] for song in queue if song['song_id'] in liked_song_ids]
print("Positions to remove:", positions_to_remove)

# Remove from highest position to lowest to avoid index shifting
for pos in sorted(positions_to_remove, reverse=True):
    result = apis.spotify.remove_song_from_queue(access_token=access_token, position=pos)
    print(f"Removed position {pos}: {result}")
